business_summary: Talen Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: TLN) owns the Susquehanna nuclear plant and a broader dispatchable generation fleet. It is the counterparty on one of the earliest and largest direct nuclear-to-hyperscaler power deals, expanding its Susquehanna relationship with Amazon Web Services, making it a bellwether name for behind-the-meter and co-located nuclear power for AI data centers.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (2518000000 / 3209000000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 (fiscal 2023 has no companyfacts entry; the CAGR uses the two endpoint years only).

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TLN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss -90000000 divided by Revenues 2518000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts. Operating income is negative: this GAAP figure for a merchant generator is commonly distorted by non-cash mark-to-market swings on power hedges.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TLN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 704000000 divided by net loss -219000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts. Net income is negative while operating cash flow is positive, a common split for merchant generators whose GAAP earnings carry non-cash mark-to-market items that do not move cash.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TLN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 704000000 less capital expenditure 98000000 = 606000000.0, divided by revenue 2518000000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TLN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 9312000000 (total debt 9543000000 less cash 231000000, both as of 2026-06-30) divided by an EBITDA proxy 189000000 (operating income -90000000 plus depreciation and amortization 279000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31). The EBITDA proxy is near zero because fiscal-2025 GAAP operating income was negative, so this multiple reads as extreme leverage; it is much more a statement about mark-to-market-distorted GAAP operating income for a merchant generator than about Talen's real debt-service capacity, which the company's own non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA (not a canonical field here) would show very differently.
